name: @elixir-mcp/ui
description: Elixir's React kit on its design: the chrome, the rail and its identity block, the page parts (head, tabs, chips, panel, table, empty and error states, stats), the one log table, freshness, Markdown, icons, the error boundary, the disclaimer. Sources are TypeScript; the web app and the site consume them through the workspace. Styles are the design package's - nothing here restyles them.
